image_description: A close-up portrait of a rooster (cock) head and neck. The subject features a prominent, bright red serrated comb and wattles, black iridescent plumage on the neck, and a yellow beak. The eye is sharp with a visible catchlight. A signature 'Eric' is visible in the bottom right corner.
